counting_rule: Distinct platforms only. Experimental, research, demo, and disabled workflows are not production sources.

candidates.access: **Public candidate.** Unauthenticated `https://{company}.pinpointhq.com/postings.json`; use postings, not deprecated jobs endpoint.
candidates.blocker: Not live. Empty-identity validation is not historical/cross-source deduplication or database acceptance.
candidates.next_action: Complete backend contracts, isolated database replay/verification, TEST cloud validation, reuse review and approval-gated rollout.

candidates.access: **Public candidate.** `https://api.manatal.com/open/v3/career-page/{client_slug}/jobs/`; paginated career-page API. Full account API is separate and token protected.

candidates.next_action: Complete backend contracts, isolated database replay/verification, TEST cloud validation, reuse review and approval-gated rollout.

candidates.access: **Public candidate, documentation conflict.** Public API overview says no token; endpoint schema mentions Bearer. `https://api.talentlyft.com/v2/public/{subdomain}/jobs`.

candidates.next_action: Validate current provider access and real US employer feed; implement adapter only after non-demo probe.
